text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... that's too bad. As expected,
this game really is quite difficult...
choice_data_list: Sorry, let me try one more time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, no! That's already more than enough...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You tried so hard for me...
Just knowing that made me so very happy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So, please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
